other_conditions: Must be a person with disabilities
Must be a beneficiary of the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
Must possess a MGNREGA job card
Must have livelihood primarily dependent on agriculture
Must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family if not eligible under SC/ST/Primitive Tribes
benefits_summary: Provides plantation of fruit‑bearing and fodder trees with usufruct rights and up to 100 days of employment under MGNREGA, generating sustainable livelihoods for marginalized families.
